description: Misidentified call subject. User asked for prep sheet for call with 'HASC and Stephen'. Searched Microsoft 365 but found email thread about Stephen Johnson and Systemic Compliance. Incorrectly concluded the call was with Systemic Compliance (Kevin & Robin Graham) instead of finding what HASC actually is. Built entire prep sheet on wrong target company.
